[Roadmap]Prefill Context Parallel Refactor#27252
Copy link

Description

Fridge003
opened on Jun 4, 2026
Issue body actions

This refactor design is generated by Codex under supervision. Technical details are prone to changes, but the overall design will not change.

Motivation

The current context parallelism (CP) implementation has grown around model- and
backend-specific branches. This makes the behavior hard to reason about and hard
to extend.

Main issues:

  • Server args are confusing. Generic CP, DSA CP, and deprecated NSA aliases use
    separate flags and mode fields, even though they describe the same two CP
    sharding strategies.
  • CP sharding logic is coupled with model code and attention backend code.
    Zigzag (in-seq-split) and interleave (round-robin-split) are model-agnostic
    layouts, but today each model family wires them differently.
  • Model coverage is asymmetric. DSA models support both zigzag and interleave;
    MLA and GQA models historically mostly supported zigzag; DeepSeek V4 uses
    interleave. The draft CP-v2 path now also validates Qwen3 interleave, which
    is a useful GQA/MoE example for the new abstraction.
  • Legacy communication code is scattered. communicator_dsa_cp.py, CP branches
    in model files, DSA indexer logic, and attention backend logic all own pieces
    of the same layout transition.
  • Some topology choices are hardcoded in server args, such as forcing
    enable_dp_attention=True / dp_size=1 for interleave-style paths.

The goal is to make CP a strategy-owned runtime abstraction: server args select
whether CP is enabled and which strategy to use; models and attention backends
call strategy interfaces instead of open-coding CP-specific branches.

Design

1. How Server Args Usage Changes

Before, CP had overlapping flags:

--enable-prefill-context-parallel
--prefill-cp-mode {in-seq-split}
--enable-dsa-prefill-context-parallel
--dsa-prefill-cp-mode {in-seq-split,round-robin-split}
--enable-nsa-prefill-context-parallel
--nsa-prefill-cp-mode
--attn-cp-size N

After, CP has one enable flag and one strategy axis:

--enable-prefill-cp
--cp-strategy {zigzag,interleave}
--attn-cp-size N

Deprecated mode values map to the new strategy names:

Deprecated value New strategy
in-seq-split zigzag
round-robin-split interleave

Deprecated boolean flags are still accepted and mirrored into
enable_prefill_cp:

--enable-prefill-context-parallel
--enable-dsa-prefill-context-parallel
--enable-nsa-prefill-context-parallel

The normalized server args initialize a process-wide CP strategy singleton.
The runtime execution path remains gated by SGLANG_ENABLE_CP_V2 during the
transition.

2. CP Strategy Design

#27313 lands the strategy abstraction scaffolding and process-wide strategy
initialization. CP strategy classes own the common policy surface for a CP layout:

  • whether CP can apply for a forward batch;
  • how per-forward CP metadata is built;
  • how hidden states and position IDs are sharded;
  • how rank-local hidden states and KV payloads are gathered;
  • how per-request sharding will be expressed by strategies that need it;
  • how model inputs are split before model.forward;
  • how attention dispatch, KV materialization, and attention metadata reindexing
    will be routed once the model/backend migrations land.

The module layout is:

python/sglang/srt/layers/cp/
  __init__.py      # package exports, including singleton helpers from base.py
  base.py          # enums, base metadata, ContextParallelStrategy ABC, singleton helpers
  zigzag.py        # implemented former in-seq-split strategy and zigzag metadata
  interleave.py    # former round-robin-split strategy shell and interleave metadata
  utils.py         # public import facade for strategy classes and metadata

There is no separate strategy.py in this PR. The process-wide helpers live in
base.py; utils.py is only the public import facade for strategy classes and
metadata types.

Class definitions:

class ContextParallelStrategy(ABC):
    name: str
    kind: ContextParallelStrategyKind
    cp_size: int
    cp_rank: int
    per_layer_attn_cp_comm: bool

    def can_apply(self, num_tokens, forward_batch) -> bool: ...
    def build_metadata(self, num_tokens, seqs_len, extend_seqs_len=None): ...
    def shard_hidden_states(self, x, forward_batch): ...
    def shard_position_ids(self, positions, forward_batch): ...
    def gather_hidden_states(self, x, forward_batch, stream=None): ...
    def gather_kv_cache(self, x, forward_batch, stream=None): ...
    def shard_per_request(self, extend_seqs_cpu, extend_seqs): ...
    def split_before_forward(self, forward_batch, input_ids, positions, input_embeds=None): ...
    def run_attention(self, q, forward_batch, device, attn_fn, attention_backend): ...
    def materialize_full_kv(self, forward_batch, layer, k, v): ...
    def reindex_attn_metadata(self, core_attn_metadata): ...

class ZigzagCPStrategy(ContextParallelStrategy): ...
class InterleaveCPStrategy(ContextParallelStrategy): ...

Process-wide helpers added by #27313:

def init_cp_strategy(server_args) -> None: ...
def get_cp_strategy(): ...
def get_cp_strategy_kind() -> ContextParallelStrategyKind: ...
def is_cp_enabled() -> bool: ...
def is_zigzag() -> bool: ...
def is_interleave() -> bool: ...

ServerArgs._handle_context_parallelism() now calls init_cp_strategy(self)
after legacy CP arguments are normalized and validated. If enable_prefill_cp is
false, or attn_cp_size <= 1, the singleton is cleared. Otherwise,
cp_strategy={zigzag,interleave} binds either ZigzagCPStrategy or
InterleaveCPStrategy.

get_cp_strategy() also lazily initializes from global server args. This lets
worker processes recover the singleton after deserialization, where
ServerArgs.__post_init__ is not rerun. The singleton and compatibility
predicates are intentionally visible under both CP-v1 and CP-v2. The
SGLANG_ENABLE_CP_V2 env var is introduced as a default-off runtime rollout
flag for future CP-v2 dispatch, but #27313 does not make get_cp_strategy()
return None when that env var is false.

Metadata definitions:

  • BaseContextParallelMetadata stores total_seq_lens and bs.
  • ZigzagContextParallelMetadata extends it with the former in-seq-split
    permutation fields, per-rank token counts, per-sequence FlashAttention tensors,
    and CPU-side diagnostic lists. ContextParallelMetadata remains an alias to
    the zigzag metadata shape.
  • InterleaveContextParallelMetadata extends the base metadata and currently has
    no extra per-forward payload.

Class relationship:

    class ContextParallelStrategy {

    BaseContextParallelMetadata <|-- ZigzagContextParallelMetadata

    ContextParallelStrategy <|-- ZigzagCPStrategy

Loading

Initialization flow added by #27313:

flowchart TD
    A["ServerArgs._handle_legacy_cp_arguments()"] --> B["ServerArgs._handle_context_parallelism()"]
    B --> C["validate canonical CP config"]
    C --> D["init_cp_strategy(self)"]
    D --> E["base._STRATEGY"]
    E --> F["get_cp_strategy()"]
    E --> G["get_cp_strategy_kind() / is_cp_enabled() / is_zigzag() / is_interleave()"]
    F --> H["future CP-v2 model, attention, and communicator dispatch"]
Loading

The two strategies differ only in layout policy at this stage:

  • ZigzagCPStrategy represents the former in-seq-split layout. It splits each
    sequence into 2 * cp_size blocks and gives each rank one early block and one
    late block. This balances causal attention cost. Its shell currently builds
    base zigzag metadata and leaves concrete sharding, gather, attention dispatch,
    and KV materialization to follow-up PRs.
  • InterleaveCPStrategy represents the former round-robin-split layout. It
    assigns token i to rank i % cp_size. Its shell currently builds base
    interleave metadata and leaves concrete sharding, gather, attention dispatch,
    and KV materialization to follow-up PRs.

3. Model Runner CP-v2 Boundary

#28421 keeps CP-v2 sequence sharding and final gather at the runner boundary
instead of embedding that orchestration in Qwen model files. The original merge
wired this path in model_runner.py; after the later runner refactor, the eager
extend implementation lives in
python/sglang/srt/model_executor/runner/eager_runner.py, while
model_runner.py remains the top-level dispatcher and avoids prefill CUDA graph
replay when a CP strategy is configured.

For an active CP-v2 extend batch, the eager runner now:

  1. calls is_cp_v2_active(forward_batch) after forward metadata initialization;
  2. calls prepare_cp_forward(forward_batch) to build
    forward_batch.attn_cp_metadata;
  3. materializes complete input embeddings when input_embeds is absent;
  4. calls cp_split_before_forward(...) to produce rank-local hidden states and
    position IDs;
  5. runs model_runner.model.model(...) directly with sharded embeddings and
    positions, bypassing the model wrapper's legacy CP/logits path;
  6. on the final PP rank, calls cp_gather_after_forward(...) before invoking
    the logits processor.

This makes the model boundary responsible for only two layout transitions:

  • full input embeddings/positions -> rank-local CP layout before the model body;
  • rank-local hidden states -> full token order before logits.

The attention backend owns the per-layer CP-v2 attention transitions. In
FlashAttention, when is_cp_v2_active(forward_batch) is true:

  • KV cache writes call cp_strategy.materialize_full_kv(...);
  • attention calls route through cp_strategy.run_attention(...).

4. How To Handle Communication

Communication should be owned by the layer that naturally owns the layout
transition:

  • Interconnect communication between CP and EP/DP/TP, such as gather/scatter
    around MLP, is handled by communicator.py.
  • AllGather before attention kernels is handled by CP strategies through
    gather_kv_cache / materialize_full_kv.
  • Scatter/gather at model entry and exit is handled by CP strategies through
    split_before_forward and gather helpers.
  • communicator_dsa_cp.py should be removed. Communication operations should
    not be exposed directly in modeling files such as dsa_indexer.py or
    deepseek_v4.py.

The base communicator owns CP SCATTERED/FULL hidden-state transitions:

flowchart TD
    L["LayerCommunicator.__init__"] --> C["CommunicateContext.init_new()"]
    C --> Gate["_is_attn_cp_layer_comm_enabled()"]
    Gate -->|false| Normal["normal communicator dispatch tables"]
    Gate -->|true| CPTable["CP dispatch table"]

    CPTable --> A["prepare_attn: SCATTERED -> SCATTERED"]
    CPTable --> B["prepare_mlp: SCATTERED -> FULL or SCATTERED"]
    CPTable --> D["postprocess_layer: FULL or SCATTERED -> SCATTERED"]

    B --> Gather["_cp_gather_hidden_states_and_residual"]
    D --> Scatter["_cp_scatter_hidden_states"]
    Gather --> AG["attn_cp_all_gather_into_tensor"]
    Scatter --> RS["attn_cp_reduce_scatter_tensor"]
Loading

Exact layout dispatch should run before same-group-size shortcuts, because under
CP two tensors can have the same process group size while still representing
different token layouts.

5. Backward Compatibility Design

The refactor should merge gradually and stay off by default until the new path
has enough coverage.

CP-v2 runtime dispatch is controlled by SGLANG_ENABLE_CP_V2.

enable_cp_v2() reads SGLANG_ENABLE_CP_V2 through
sglang.srt.environ.envs. is_cp_v2_active(forward_batch) is the runtime
dispatch predicate for per-batch CP-v2 execution; it additionally requires
context-parallel extend mode, an initialized strategy, input_ids, and
strategy.can_apply(...).

When SGLANG_ENABLE_CP_V2=0, server args still normalize the CP configuration
and initialize the strategy singleton for compatibility predicates. Runtime
dispatch should use is_cp_v2_active(forward_batch), not get_cp_strategy()
alone. When SGLANG_ENABLE_CP_V2=1, is_cp_v2_active(forward_batch) exposes
active batches to model runner, attention backends, model bodies, and
communication code.

Compatibility details:

  • Deprecated CLI flags are still parsed and warn.
  • Deprecated mode flags also enable enable_prefill_cp.
  • ContextParallelMetadata remains importable as an alias to the zigzag
    metadata shape.
  • cp/utils.py exposes CP-v2 helper names such as enable_cp_v2,
    is_cp_v2_active, prepare_cp_forward, cp_split_before_forward, and
    cp_gather_after_forward.
  • Non-DSA deprecated predicates preserve their old server-args semantics.
  • DSA deprecated predicates remain in attention/dsa/utils.py while the CP-v2
    runtime helpers live in cp/utils.py.

Roadmap

An example PR for this refactor effort can be found at #25957. It will be split into a series of smaller PRs as the following plan:

  • Simplify the server args usage with the new ones [1/n] [CP] Simplify prefill context parallel server args #27312
  • Add CP strategy abstractions.
    • defined classes, metadata, add related unit tests, and add the flag SGLANG_ENABLE_CP_V2 for backward compatibility. [2/n] [CP] Add context parallel strategy abstractions #27313
    • Implement member functions of zigzag strategy [3/N][CP] Implement zigzag CP strategy #28421
    • Implement member functions of interleave strategy [4/N][CP] Support interleave strategy for cp v2 #30482
  • Move communication ownership into the common communicator. [5/N][CP] Concentrate CP communication ownership in communicator #28775
    • Fold DSA CP SCATTERED/FULL transitions into communicator.py.
    • Remove communicator_dsa_cp.py.
    • Keep model files focused on model computation rather than layout
      communication.
  • Implement the new CP design on covered model families
    • Support GQA models, starting with Qwen3, also include GPT-OSS/Mimo V2.5 Support MiMo V2.5 with zigzag context parallelism #29972
    • Support MLA models, including Kimi K2.5 and DeepSeek V3 [CP] Migrate MLA prefill CP (DeepSeek V3) to CP-v2 zigzag strategy #31619
    • Support DSA models, including GLM-5 and DeepSeek-V3.2 [4/N][CP] Support interleave strategy for cp v2 #30482
    • Support DeepSeek V4 with the new CP implementation [CP]: Support CP V2 Strategy for dsv4 #33532
  • Enhance the Context Parallel tests with long context pressure tests.
  • Flip SGLANG_ENABLE_CP_V2 to True and deprecate old CP implementation
    • Deprecate CP V1 tests [CP V1 Deprecation 1/5] Migrate tests to strategy-based prefill CP #36222
    • Remove server args/environ settings related to CP V1 [CP V1 Deprecation 2/5] Make strategy prefill CP canonical #36223
    • Remove old logics in CP V1 logics [CP V1 Deprecation 3/5] Remove generic prefill CP v1 runtime #36228 [CP V1 Deprecation 3.5/5] Deprecate HIP/NPU/MUSA prefill CP and remove legacy implementation #38293
    • Canonicalize prefill CP API names [CP V1 Deprecation 4/5] Canonicalize prefill CP API names #36229
    • Update documentation for prefill CP V2 [CP V1 Deprecation 5/5] Update prefill CP documentation #36230
  • Future enhancement, such as supporting more attention backends with CP, or adding documents
